title: Members
summary: Platform → Members: one table of everyone with a role binding, their summed roles (Superadmin, Platform admin, Product admin for one product or all, narrowed to areas, Console access), where each role came from, and invites as bindings on an email. The root rule is shown above the table and its members cannot be removed here.
compare: The sidebar is the Platform context with Members active; the page has three tabs: Members (10), SSO rules (3) and Roles.

The root-rule callout sits above the table: 'Root rule: everyone in polaris-admins is a Superadmin' with a link to SSO rules. There is no edit or remove control on it; the deploy-time variable is named on SSO rules only.

Each row shows the person's roles as tags that add up: Superadmin (crown), Platform admin (shield), '<Product> admin' with the product logo, 'All products admin' (layers glyph), and Console access only when the person has nothing else. Every other role implies Console access, so it never appears beside them.
An area-narrowed Product admin shows the areas after a divider with each area's service glyph (Diceroll admin · Ship builds, Commerce). No Product editor or Product viewer role exists.

'Access from' lists every source of a binding on its own line: Root rule, SSO rule (rule name or matched domain in mono), Added by <person> with a date, Created <product> (the creator becomes that product's admin), Invite.

Invites are rows in the same table: the email as the title, a dashed mail avatar (that is what says pending), who invited and when, and the role they will get. They are not a separate list or tab; the tab's count of 10 is the number of rows, and the table has no footer line.

The row menu on a root-rule member (drawn in Other states) offers Edit roles, Sign out everywhere and Show activity; 'Remove from console' is unavailable and the menu says why and what to do instead (take the person out of polaris-admins at Pocket ID).

The row menu on a member whose only role comes from an SSO rule (Lucía, Other states) offers 'Add a role…' (a direct binding on top of the rule's role), 'Edit rule <name>' for Superadmins only, Sign out everywhere and Show activity; 'Remove from console' is locked and says removing isn't possible while the rule matches. Diceroll → Settings → Members offers the same as 'Add areas…'.

Last console sign-in shows the time and the method (Passkey, Pocket ID, Studio Okta); below 1280px it folds into the member's second line (email · Passkey, today). No row ever shows an email-code sign-in, because an email code alone never opens the console.
Only Superadmins and Platform admins see this page; the list is the same for both, but a Platform admin's Edit roles cannot grant Superadmin or Platform admin.

Phone: the table becomes stacked rows (avatar, name and email with the menu at the right, then the role tags and the access sources indented under the name); each role tag takes its own line, and a narrowed role shows its areas (glyph and name) on the line under the tag, outside it, so the tag never wraps into a box. The access sources flow on one line per card, without their dates; the three filters scroll sideways in one row; the open row menus are drawn in Other states only.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.
Members · SSO rules · Roles stay an underline tablist (not a bordered segmented tray); the search and filters are the table's head band; no lone section numerals (admin-4-05).
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): Role scope is shown per member
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): SSO sources ('Access from') are shown
Preserved (guide Ed. 04): The immutable root recovery rule is visible and cannot be removed here

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Pass with minor polish; all three minor findings applied.

findings.issue: The tab reads 'Members 10' but the table footer reads '8 members • 2 invites waiting'.
findings.resolution: The footer now reads '10 people: 8 members, 2 invites waiting', counting the same rows as the tab (invites are rows in the same table).

findings.issue: On phone a role tag narrowed to areas wraps into a two-line rounded box and loses its divider.
findings.resolution: Narrowed roles use a role-set: on desktop the tag, a divider and the areas still read as one tag; on phone the tag stands alone and the areas (service glyph and name) sit on the next line outside it, one role per line. The same markup is used on Invite, SSO rules, Product members and No access, so the tag looks the same everywhere.

findings.issue: Members whose only role comes from a rule get a ⋯ menu here but 'Set by a rule' on the product Members page, and nothing shows what Edit roles does to such a role.
findings.resolution: Added an Other states board with Lucía's row menu: 'Add a role…' (a direct binding on top of the rule), 'Edit rule diceroll-store' (Superadmins only), Sign out everywhere, Show activity, and a locked 'Remove from console' saying removing isn't possible while the rule matches. Product members mirrors it with 'Add areas…'. Jonas's root-rule note no longer uses pronouns.

findings.issue: The open Jonas row menu covered the Access from and Last sign-in cells, the data the page is for; row heights were uneven (57, 61, 57, 59, 61px).
findings.resolution: The menu moved to Other states beside Lucía's; every row is a fixed 56px with two-line cells inside it (kit .table.rows-56).

findings.issue: The count, the pending state and the env var were each stated twice.
findings.resolution: Table footer deleted; invited rows drop 'Waiting for first sign-in' (the dashed envelope avatar and 'Invited by' say it); the banner reads 'Root rule: everyone in polaris-admins is a Superadmin' with the Open SSO rules link; PLATFORM_ADMIN_GROUP stays on SSO rules only.

findings.issue: Gaps between header, tabs, banner, filters and table were uneven, and the dashed chips looked like another component family.
findings.resolution: One 24px gap between all of them (.page.gap-6, .section.gap-6); filter chips are solid 1px bordered pills (.filter.solid).

findings.issue: Columns and filters disappeared without a trace below desktop; phone cards ran up to 7 lines.
findings.resolution: Tablet folds the last sign-in into the member's second line (email · Passkey, today); phone keeps all three filters in one sideways-scrolling row with a faded edge; the access sources flow on one line per card (dates and 'Added by' drop).

findings.issue: Tables stretched to about 1615px at 1920, so cells sat 275px or more apart and the page widths differed across the area.
findings.resolution: Pages cap at one content width, centred: 1280px for tables, 1136px for forms and status pages (kit .page.cap-table, .page.cap-form).

findings.issue: Small muted mono keys, dates and helper text carried facts at subtle colour and under 12px; disabled buttons were near invisible; row-menu targets were 28px.
findings.resolution: Fact-bearing small text moves to the muted token and 12px or more; the light subtle token is #4f586d (4.5:1 or better on every surface in both themes); disabled buttons keep a visible border at 0.6 opacity (0.8 on primary); the row-menu trigger is 32px with a 44px hit area (44px on phone); colour-only Adds and Joins carry a glyph.

findings.issue: Other states left 120 to 700px of dead space beside shorter cards, and the captions narrated layout.
findings.resolution: Other states sit on one equal-width grid (3 columns from desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on phone) with the page's card primitive; captions name the state and its trigger.

findings.issue: Use the free width at wide for a right rail with the Root rule card and role counts.
findings.resolution: declined: It adds duplicate content, and the Root rule already appears in the banner and rows. Capping the width is enough.

findings.issue: Add a selected-member detail panel at wide.
findings.resolution: declined: It is new functionality and outside a spacing pass.

findings.issue: Show 'Waiting for first sign-in' as a pill in the Last sign-in cell.
findings.resolution: declined: The dashed pending avatar and the 'Invited by' line already carry the state. Another pill adds duplication.

findings.issue: h1 plus tabs is the kit's pattern; role names and the glossary are owner and consolidation-plan decisions.
findings.resolution: declined: Change the h1 to match each tab, add breadcrumbs on platform pages, or add 'Rename Console access to Viewer' and a glossary entry.

findings.issue: Date and glossary rules belong to the copy rules and the consolidation plan, not to a spacing pass.
findings.resolution: declined: Rewrite dates to 'relative within 7 days, else Oct 6, year only when not current' and add the 'Product admin = one product or all' glossary note.
